plain.li: I've asked and waited and asked again, and I'm done asking.
Somewhere out there there must be people who listen, and I'm going to find them.
In three days I'm taking my boots and walking until this place is a smudge behind me.
[winter] I'd rather freeze out there than keep being ignored in here.
[small] You can't afford to lose me, so start acting like it.

warm.li: I don't want to go, but I can't keep being invisible here.

blunt.li: I'm leaving. Don't bother packing me a lunch.
You've got three days to treat me like I exist, and then I'm gone.

cheerful.li: Good news, I've found a cure for being let down by this colony, and it's leaving!

gloomy.li: I'll probably die out there alone, but at least it'll be my choice.
You won't even notice I've gone, which is the whole trouble.

cold.li: My skills are worth more somewhere they're valued. I'll be taking them there.

plain.li: Fine. I'll unpack my things, and we'll see how long they stay unpacked.
Somebody finally listened. Took long enough.

warm.li: I'm glad I don't have to go. I'd have missed you all, even the loud ones.

blunt.li: I'm staying. Don't make me regret it.

cheerful.li: Never mind, I'm staying! Please forget everything I said, especially the shouting.

gloomy.li: Where would I even have gone? I'll stay.

cold.li: The situation has improved enough. I'll stay while that remains true.

plain.li: Don't follow me, and don't send word. You wouldn't know where to send it.
Good luck with the next raid, one pair of hands short.

warm.li: Take care of each other. Better than you took care of me.

blunt.li: Bye. Keep the bed. It was a bad bed.

cheerful.li: So long! It was mostly terrible, but some of you were nice.

gloomy.li: I won't look back. There's nothing back there that looked at me.

cold.li: Consider this my resignation. Effective immediately.
